newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak '96 foreign trade deficit seen at SKK37.7 bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak '96 foreign trade deficit seen at SKK37.7 bln.

text.p: The Slovak finance ministry on Tuesday said it expected the country's foreign trade deficit to total about 37.7 billion crowns by the end of this year and widen to around 61.3 billion in 1997.
The figures were included in a study on personal tax and government social outlays for the next four years to be presented to the cabinet.

The document said the trade deficit was expected to gradually increase by the year 2000, totalling some 78.6 billion crowns in 1998, around 89.3 billion in 1999 and around 98.3 billion in the year 2000.
